_comment: Agent-level scenarios on the synthetic baseline mailbox (indexer/tests/baseline/corpus.py). Each names the tools an agent should reach for first (expected_tools, alternatives), a call budget (max_calls) and one golden question in tests/baseline/golden.json: golden_search inherits that question's required_evidence and filters (as expected arguments), golden_enumerate its args and expected messages, golden_unanswerable makes the scenario expect abstention. required_citations (golden_search only) lists message refs the answer must cite: the correcting reply for a correction, each side for conflicting sources. A counting scenario names no golden question: expected_answer_messages lists the message refs the answer must cite, exactly (no decoys, none missing), and whose number answer.count must equal; full_read_messages lists those the trace must page through get_message to the end; forbidden_answer_text lists strings (one-time PINs, verification links) answer.text must not contain. tofu-count reads TOFU as one-time sign-in PINs and email verifications (corpus threads 38-41; 42-45 are decoys). An outstanding_items scenario (#798) also names no golden question: its ground truth (next actions with owner, status, due date and required sources; forbidden sources; completeness blockers; full reads) is in outstanding_items.json under its id, never in what an answering agent reads; counsel-outstanding uses corpus threads 46-65 and its held-out variant marina-counsel-follow-ups threads 66-74. held_out must equal tests/agent_metrics.py is_held_out(id); held-out scenarios are never used to tune anything. Scored by tests/agent_metrics.py; tests/test_agent_eval.py checks the reference traces in agent_reference_traces.json against them. Synthetic data only.
